results.title: The upload extensions and the media types agree
results.evidence: the browser upload control offers '.json' and the API will not read 'json': `accept_attribute` builds its list from a hand-written tuple rather than from UPLOAD_FORMATS, so the two vocabularies have drifted again — this time in the direction where a picker accepts a file the upload then refuses. The comment above SUFFIXES records the same defect in the other direction
